title: Hammer-Wielding Warrior
description: A dynamic full-body illustration of a female warrior with purple hair, mid-leap in an aggressive battle pose. She grips a massive purple warhammer with glowing crackling patterns, wearing a white and purple armored outfit with matching gauntlets and greaves.
prompt: A fierce female warrior with long dark purple hair is captured mid-air in an aggressive battle stance, mouth open shouting. She wields a huge purple warhammer with glowing crackle patterns on the head. She wears a white cropped top with purple armor details, white pants with purple straps and accents, matching gauntlets and greaves. Dynamic action pose against a solid dark gray background, vibrant digital painting style with bold outlines.
